# cynkrathis

Package to simplify project scaffolding and common {renv} related tasks.

## cynkra RSPM snapshots

cynkra makes use of certain RStudio Package Manager (RSPM) snapshots
across projects. Usually each R Version is tied to a snapshot near it’s
release date. If a snapshot is considered unstable due to certain R
package version clashes, additional snapshots for specific R versions
can be listed.

``` r

head(cynkrathis::get_snapshots(), 10)
#>    id r_version r_release_date       date        type note
#> 48 NA     4.6.0     2026-04-24 2026-04-24 recommended     
#> 47 NA     4.5.3     2026-03-12 2026-03-12 recommended     
#> 46 NA     4.5.2     2025-11-01 2025-11-01 recommended     
#> 45 NA     4.5.1     2025-06-13 2025-06-13 recommended     
#> 44 NA     4.5.0     2025-04-11 2025-04-11 recommended     
#> 43 NA     4.4.3     2025-03-01 2025-03-01 recommended     
#> 42 NA     4.4.2     2024-11-01 2024-11-01 recommended     
#> 41 NA     4.4.1     2024-06-15 2024-06-15 recommended     
#> 40 NA     4.4.0     2024-04-24 2024-04-24 recommended     
#> 39 NA     4.3.3     2024-02-29 2024-02-29 recommended
```

## Initialize {renv} with a given RSPM snapshot

By default
[`init_renv()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/init_renv.md)
will select the `"recommended"` snapshot of the R version which is
currently used.

``` r

cynkrathis::init_renv()
```

## Miscellaneous helpers

See the grouped [pkgdown
reference](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/reference/index.html).

# Package index

## renv

renv helpers

- [`init_renv()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/init_renv.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Initialize renv infrastructure (cynkra way)
- [`renv_downgrade()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/renv_downgrade.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Downgrade an renv project to a specific RSPM
  snapshot
- [`renv_install_local()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/renv_install_local.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Build a local package and install it into an
  renv project
- [`renv_switch_r_version()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/renv_switch_r_version.md)
  : Switch between R versions in renv projects

## RStudio Connect

RStudio Connect helpers

- [`deploy_minicran_package()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/deploy.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Deployment helpers for internal minicran
  packages

## Miscellaneous

Optional project scaffolding helpers

- [`get_snapshots()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/get_snapshots.md)
  : Return metadata for cynkra RSPM snapshots

- [`init_precommit()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/init_precommit.md)
  : Use precommit with that project

- [`init_tic()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/init_tic.md)
  : Initialize tic CI structure

- [`init_gitignore()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/init_gitignore.md)
  : Write fully equipped gitignore files

- [`init_lintr()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/init_lintr.md)
  : Initialize lintr config

- [`use_aviator()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/use_aviator.md)
  : Install Aviator for a repository

- [`register_cynkra()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/cynkra-desc.md)
  [`add_cynkra_ror()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/cynkra-desc.md)
  :

  Register cynkra in `DESCRIPTION`

- [`use_cynkra_upkeep_issue()`](https://cynkrathis.cynkra.com/dev/reference/use_cynkra_upkeep_issue.md)
  : Create an issue containing a checklist of upkeep tasks
